title: Products of abelian groups are exact
statement: The category $\operatorname{Ab}$ of abelian groups [def-sp-abelian] has exact (countable) products: for every family of short exact sequences $0\to A_i\to B_i\to C_i\to0$ of abelian groups, $i\in I$, the sequence $0\to\prod_iA_i\to\prod_iB_i\to\prod_iC_i\to0$ is exact.

source.place: used in Tag 07KW/07KY (products of abelian groups are exact, so Tag 07KC applies to D(Ab))
